newsitem.title: UK: Europe raw cotton sees mill demand cautious.
newsitem.headline: Europe raw cotton sees mill demand cautious.

text.p: Mill demand stayed cautious in the absence of significant price moves on most European raw cotton markets.
Spinners again mainly inquired for supply available for second and, in particular, third quarter shiupment.

Some merchants' price ideas for that period, especially for Central Asian cotton, have begun to look decidedly firmer as the prospect recedes that extra quantities may be available at origin from the present crop.,
Buying interest for new crop cotton remained light.
